The **URX Core M1 Wireless** is the top overall lightweight option in this price range. Choosing a wireless gaming mouse under ₹2,000 in India requires balancing weight, sensor performance, and latency.

---

### Top Picks Under ₹2,000

| Model | Weight | Connectivity | Sensor / Performance | Standout Feature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **URX Core M1** | **54 g** | 2.4GHz / BT / Wired | PixArt PAW3311 | Ultra-lightweight, 100M optical switches (no double-clicking) |
| **Cosmic Byte Atlas** | **~65 g** | 2.4GHz Wireless / Wired | Up to 10,000 DPI | Solid honeycomb/lightweight chassis, fast glide |
| **Arctic Fox Alien-X** | **~65 g** | 2.4GHz / BT / Wired | 1000Hz Polling / 4800 DPI | Budget tri-mode, rechargeable Type-C |
| **Redragon Trident Pro M693** | **~90 g** | 2.4GHz / BT / Wired | 8000 DPI | Highly durable build, comfortable shape |

---

### Key Things to Know Before Buying

* **True Ultralight Performance (<65g):** The **URX Core M1** (54g) offers competitive-grade performance with its PixArt PAW3311 sensor and optical switches, which are immune to mechanical double-clicking issues.
* **The "Logitech G304" Alternative:** The popular **Logitech G304 Wireless** often dips to ₹2,200–₹2,400 during sales. While it has a superior HERO sensor, it weighs around **99g** with an AA battery. It is not considered ultralight unless modded with an AAA battery adapter (~85g).
* **Battery Type:** Look for rechargeable lithium-polymer models with Type-C connectivity if you want to avoid buying AA/AAA batteries.
